content.title: Grande Cuvée
content.subtitle: 172ème Édition, Champagne Brut
content.intro: Krug’s signature blend of 146 wines from 11 years. Expect white flowers, lemon and almond, with brioche, honey and a long, fresh finish.
content.taste_note: A guide, not a measurement of this bottle.
content.flavor_note: Also look for lavender, violet, marzipan, gingerbread and a hint of menthol.
content.glass: A white Burgundy glass rather than a flute.
content.pair_note: It pairs widely, from simple to grand.
content.vintage: Built around 2016: a very wet spring, with 70% more rain than normal, then clement weather and a heatwave at the end. Picking ran from September 9 to October 2. Reserve wines back to 1998 make up 42% of the blend.
place: Krug’s cellars are in Reims. Its library of reserve wines from many years is what makes each blend possible.
Joseph Krug wanted the best Champagne he could make every year, whatever the weather. So each Grande Cuvée blends many years.
The six digits on the back label unlock this bottle’s story on Krug’s app or site, including its blend.
